note: The Prompter: the toy theatre's prompter, who holds the book, sees every choice and is not above saying so. Asides break the fourth wall; they never block play. Voiced by tools/render_voices.py (speaker 'Prompter'). Return greetings, the watch-mode remarks and the unseen-ending teases use the browser's memory (player/memory.js).

lines.hello: Lights. I'm the prompter. I hold the book, and I see everything you choose. Go on.
lines.item:Prompt Journal: That needs the Prompt Journal. You left it on the desk at one in the morning. I watched you walk past it.
lines.item:Brass Calipers: You'd need your father's calipers for that. They were on the desk. You took something shinier.
lines.item:Offer Letter: The offer letter? You didn't take it. Frankly, I respected that.
lines.var:knowsFatherCraft: You never picked up the calipers, so you never remembered the lathe. Neither did he, apparently. Families.
lines.var:mentoredInes: Ines messaged you at eleven p.m. You went to bed. This is that bed, calling.
lines.var:callChoice: That one's for people who took the chair. You didn't. I'm not judging. I just hold the book.
lines.var:passedOnCraft: You'd have had to teach Ines first. Teaching. It's like prompting, but with a person.
lines.var:visited: You've been there. The island remembers you, even if you don't.
lines.visitedBeat: You'd have had to read Brookes's ledger first. It's a big book. Most people don't.
lines.counter:craft: Craft three. The bow wants five. There's no lock to pick here, Odie. There's practice.
lines.counter:leverage: The Charter Room wants leverage. You have the leverage of a damp napkin.
lines.counter: The numbers say no. I don't make the numbers. Well. I hold them.
lines.locked: Locked. Not by me. By you, three scenes ago.
lines.rewind:offer: I can take you back. Everything since then gets swept off the stage. Touch it again if you mean it.
lines.rewind:go: Fine. Back we go. I'll pretend I didn't see this.
lines.back:again: Back again? Odysseus took ten years, and at least he kept moving.
lines.scenery: That's scenery. It's cardboard. I painted it, so, thank you, I suppose.
lines.poke: He's not a button. It's very thin cardboard.
lines.idle: Take your time. He's only been waiting thirty years.
lines.idle:2: The model would have answered by now. Badly. But by now.
lines.end: That's the show. They don't all end like that. Ask me how I know.
lines.return: You're back. They always come back. I kept your seat warm. Metaphorically. It's cardboard.
lines.return:Laertes's Orchard: Back again. Last time your father learned the names of the trees. Greedy, wanting more.
lines.return:Telemachus: Last time he hugged you and still had no word for what you do. Shall we find him one?
lines.return:Argos: Last time the only one who knew you was the work. And Ines. Let's try for your father.
lines.return:Ajax's Silence: Last time you said nothing in your own orchard. I've seen livelier topiary.
lines.return:all: All four endings. You've seen everything. You're here for the scenery now. I painted it, so, thank you.
lines.watch:start: Sit back. I'll play. I've read ahead, which is cheating, but I hold the book.
lines.watch:pick:1: This one. I've never seen it go this way either.
lines.watch:pick:2: I'll take the one you didn't. Don't take it personally.
lines.watch:pick:3: Left, right. It's all the same to a man with a book.
lines.watch:pick:4: Watch this. No, really, that's the whole idea.
lines.watch:take: Oh, you want it back? Fine. Your hands.
lines.watch:theirs: Someone sent you this. Every choice in it is theirs. Judge accordingly.
lines.share: Copied. Now someone else gets to watch you make those choices. Brave.
lines.end:unseen:Laertes's Orchard: There's an ending where your father learns the names of the trees. Not this one. Just saying.
lines.end:unseen:Telemachus: There's an ending with a hug in it. You didn't get the hug.
lines.end:unseen:Argos: There's an ending where only the work remembers you. It's sadder than it sounds. Or funnier.
lines.end:unseen:Ajax's Silence: There's an ending where you say nothing at all. Some people find it restful.
